default.notes: Not eligible for unsponsored entry — a visit visa must be arranged through a sponsor in Oman (hotel, employer or relative) or an Omani embassy before travel.

groups.notes: GCC citizens may enter Oman freely under Gulf Cooperation Council arrangements — a national ID card is accepted and no visa is needed.

Visa-free entry for stays of up to 14 days — a return ticket, accommodation and health insurance are formally required; for longer visits apply for the Royal Oman Police eVisa and confirm current eligibility on evisa.rop.gov.om before travel.

IL.notes: Oman has no diplomatic relations with Israel and does not currently admit travellers on Israeli passports — policy could change; confirm with an Omani embassy before making plans.

IN.notes: Indian nationals can apply for the Royal Oman Police tourist eVisa — some applicants must hold residence or a valid visa for a Western or GCC country; confirm eligibility on evisa.rop.gov.om before booking.

OM.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Omani citizens.
